metadata.title: A Tesla-SpaceX Merger Would Hasten Musk’s $1 Trillion Payday

content.text:
LIVE
1 min ago
A Tesla-SpaceX Merger Would Hasten Musk’s $1 Trillion Payday
With all the talk of a potential Tesla-SpaceX tie-up this week, it's a good time to revisit this story explaining how a merger could unlock Musk's pay package without him hitting his targets.
